purpose: Prevent local optimization and implementation novelty from outranking the user's actual objective: improve long-run risk-adjusted wealth after costs, complexity, and attention.

primary_objective.name: incremental_expected_utility_vs_current_baseline
primary_objective.description: Evaluate every new trade, strategy, automation, data source, or system change against the best current baseline before discussing implementation.

mandatory_preflight: State the user's actual objective for this decision.
Define the current baseline and what happens if nothing changes.
Identify the incremental edge source: information, forecasting, execution, cost, risk control, or attention/time saved.
Estimate whether the incremental benefit is material after fees, taxes, slippage, complexity, failure risk, maintenance, and user attention.
State the strongest reason the proposal may NOT improve expected value.
Compare against a simpler alternative before proposing implementation.
Only then discuss HOW to implement it.

default_fail_safe.rule: If no credible incremental edge over the baseline can be identified, do not recommend implementation merely because it is technically feasible or interesting.

anti_bias_rules: Technical feasibility is not evidence of investment edge.
Automation is not alpha by itself; it can only preserve or improve an existing edge through execution, consistency, cost, risk control, or saved attention.
A high score or rank is not a mispricing thesis.
Do not create an action merely because the system can produce one.
Prefer detection and monitoring automation over execution automation unless speed or consistency is demonstrably part of the edge.
Treat novelty, elegance, and engineering interest as zero financial benefit unless they create measurable utility.
Explicitly consider that the existing Human + Quant + AI process may already be the stronger baseline.

investment_action_gate.rule: If the system cannot articulate a falsifiable mispricing thesis, score/rank alone cannot authorize BUY or ADD.

system_change_gate.rule: Prefer the smallest reversible test that can distinguish incremental value from novelty.

origin_note: Added after reviewing the autonomous trading proposal: implementation planning advanced before validating whether full automation added expected return over the existing Human + Quant + AI process.
